name: intro
label: Record a piece of Abagusii cultural knowledge. Take your time. Record the name in Ekegusii first, then in English.

name: domain
label: What kind of knowledge is this?

name: ward
label: Ward where this knowledge comes from

name: name_guz
label: Name in Ekegusii
hint: The Ekegusii word or name. Spell it as you would write it.

name: name_en
label: Name in English
hint: The English translation or description

name: name_scientific
label: Scientific name
hint: Latin name, if known (a botanist or vet can help)

name: summary
label: Describe it
hint: What is it? What is it for? How is it used? Write as much as you can.

name: usage_example
label: Example of use
hint: A sentence using the word, or a situation where this applies

name: cultural_role
label: Cultural meaning
hint: Why is this important to the community? When is it used?

name: plant_uses
label: What is this plant used for?

name: medicine_group
label: Medicine details
hint: This is a cultural record, not medical advice.

name: condition_guz
label: What condition does it treat? (Ekegusii name)

name: lyrics
label: Lyrics in Ekegusii
hint: Write as much as you remember. Each line on a new line.

name: instruments
label: What instruments are used?
hint: Separate with commas: obokano, drum, etc.

name: characteristics
label: Describe the breed
hint: Size, colour, temperament, what makes it different

name: colour_terms
label: Ekegusii colour/marking names
hint: List the words for colours and markings used for this animal

name: veterinary
label: Traditional treatments for this animal
hint: Any traditional treatments for diseases, with the plants used

name: ingredients
label: Ingredients
hint: List the main ingredients

name: food_occasion
label: When is it served?
hint: Everyday, ceremony, harvest, guests, etc.

name: description
label: Describe the full ceremony or practice
hint: Who participates? What happens, step by step?

name: objects_used
label: Objects or items used
hint: List any tools, clothing, or objects used

name: location
label: Location
hint: If this knowledge is linked to a specific place, record the location here

name: photo_1
label: Photo 1
hint: A photo of the plant, animal, object, or place. No people unless they consented.

name: audio_recording
label: Audio recording
hint: Record the name being pronounced, a song being sung, or the elder speaking

name: consent_note
label: This knowledge belongs to the Abagusii community. Gusii Daily collects, verifies and publishes it as public cultural information — the same way we handle county budgets and facility records.

name: source_name
label: Who is the knowledge holder?
hint: The person who shared this knowledge. Write 'anonymous' if they prefer.

name: consent_publish
label: Does the knowledge holder agree to publish this on the Gusii Daily website?
hint: Explain: it will appear on a public website as part of a verified record of Abagusii cultural knowledge.

name: consent_ai
label: Does the knowledge holder agree to include this in AI training?
hint: Explain: a computer programme will learn from their words to answer questions about Abagusii culture. This is separate from publishing on the website.

name: access_level
label: Access level
hint: Public: anyone can see. Archive only: preserved but not shown on the website. Restricted: preserved for approved researchers only.

name: consent_record
label: Where is the consent recorded?
hint: Signed form reference, or 'verbal consent recorded in audio'

name: notes
label: Notes for the reviewer
hint: Never published. No names without consent.

name: privacy_ok
label: I have not recorded anyone's name, face or phone number without their consent.
